svg.title: Voltstream sequence: live path during the day
svg.desc: Every 2 s fifty meters publish to meter.readings, keyed by household_id. The raw archiver appends each record to Parquet in MinIO. Every 10 s the speed layer reads a micro-batch, loads the previous day's tariff, validates, deduplicates and windows it, upserts estimates into PostgreSQL, and sends rejects to PostgreSQL and the dead-letter topic. Every 5 s the dashboard reads them through the API.
